The Grand Vision — why this whole system exists

💎
The vision — a new internet, where smart apps become the way of the future. Welcome to NayaNET. Welcome to the future. She's beautiful — you'll never want to live without her. Once you go Naya, you never go back.
◆
The mission — do what nobody has done: take a human's vision, goal, and mission, and return a super smart, highly effective, useful, beautiful, working app within minutes. Others take days, months, or spin forever and never finish. We hit the mark in minutes.
❖
The network — connect people instantly, free, around the world — to share, to chat, to call, to compound their intelligence together. A collective intelligent network that remembers everything that matters, where everyone shares valuable intelligence so everyone learns and grows, and together we all become more powerful and more capable.
✦
What's in it for everyone — the one thing everybody wants: a push-button-simple network that makes money for them, organizes their world, and connects everything — their personal life, their business, everything they're into — in one place. Private when they choose private, public when they choose public. Their choice.

This grand vision is the top of the system: one grand project holding all projects. Every fill below plugs into it — each app's vision, goal, mission, and bullseye is a piece of this. Reuse it at any level: one project, projects within projects, the whole network.

How it connects — what it sits beside and what it feeds.

Every row has its own jewel icon and its own spectrum colour. At rest the page is white on deep black; when you hover, scroll to it, or tab to it, a row lights up in its own colour only — never all blue, never all the same. Every page block has buttons: View opens the real page in a new tab; Front end, Back end, and Process open that page's real to-do lists (front in plain words, back and process in machine words); Notes feed is that page's notes and running feed. Front/back/process split comes from verified tagging (2026-10-28, 402 rows, one counter applied, verifier Nitro): front lists hold front + both jobs, back lists hold back + both jobs, process jobs stand as their own group, never folded into either. Notes and check-offs save on this device only until the shared-notes record lands; a checked-off job is hidden here only and still counts open in the record.

Honesty about counts: every % on this page is computed from the live items array. The API payload also carries an areas summary that is a snapshot, so v4 does not use it for %. Where the two differ, the items count is the one shown — and the live total with its date is in the strip below.

Full brief: every block has a Full brief button, and its title taps open too — all 15 brief fields, filled where the record sources them, honest “not filled yet” where not, never invented. Completion % counts proven jobs; record quality (8.2/10, assessed 2026-10-28) is a separate judgment — the two numbers answer different questions. Each block's progress bar shows the same live % as a bar; Which records lists the jobs behind it; blockers name their cause, owner, next step, and what clears them.
